newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle Des Eaux parks firm sold in MBO deal.
newsitem.headline: Gle Des Eaux parks firm sold in MBO deal.

text.p: French conglomerate Generale des Eaux said on Thursday its Esys Montenay unit had sold Compagnie Generale d'Espaces Vertes (CGEV) in a management buyout deal.

The buyout team, including four CGEV executives and Barclays Capital Developement, told Reuters the acquisition of the CGEV park building and maintenance firm was for a little more than 110 million francs.

The CGEV capital was bought to the tune of 49 percent by the Barclays unit and 20 percent by four CGEV executives, with a firm called Segur taking 31 percent as a "passive" investor, a represenative of the buyout team said.
